description: Show one college as a card: photo or campus map, overall admit rate and admit rate by round (Early Decision, Early Action, Regular Decision) with deadlines, SAT/ACT middle 50%, testing policy, sticker cost, average net price, graduation rate, biggest majors, and a link to its prefrosh.ai page. Use for "tell me about X", "how hard is it to get into X", "what are X's deadlines". Data is from the school's Common Data Set and federal data; cite the prefrosh.ai URL in the result.

school.description: College name as the user wrote it, e.g. "Tufts", "UNC", "Wash U".
